8:30 a.m. (ET) Friday, October 2, 2026

THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION -- SEPTEMBER 2026

Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 119,000 in September, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.4 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

The labor force participation rate, at 62.3 percent, changed little over the month.

In September, average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 12 cents, or 0.3 percent, to $36.67. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.8 percent.

In September, average hourly earnings of private-sector production and nonsupervisory employees rose by 0.2 percent.

The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for July was revised down by 10,000, from +50,000 to +40,000, and the change for August was revised down by 15,000, from +30,000 to +15,000.
